title: The infinity category of spaces and coherent corepresented functors
statement:
For each universe $\mathcal W$, use simplicial sets from [def-weil-pbc-simplicial-set], Kan complexes, geometric realization, right-pinched mapping spaces and internal functor simplicial sets from [def-cbc-enhanced-diagrams-cones], and the simplicial-category and coherent-nerve conventions of [def-coef-coherent-nerve-infrastructure]. Work in an ambient universe containing $\mathcal W$. A simplicial category has objects, simplicial sets of morphisms, identity vertices, and associative unital simplicial composition maps. Let $\mathbf{Kan}_{\mathcal W}$ be the simplicial category of $\mathcal W$-small Kan complexes, with morphism simplicial set $\operatorname{Fun}(S,T)_n=\operatorname{Hom}_{\mathrm{sSet}}(S\times\Delta^n,T)$ and composition induced by evaluation and composition of simplicial maps. Define $\mathcal S_{\mathcal W}=N_{\mathrm{hc}}(\mathbf{Kan}_{\mathcal W})$, the infinity category of $\mathcal W$-small spaces. This is the coherent nerve, retaining homotopies between maps, rather than the ordinary nerve of the underlying category.

Here is an explicit model for the covariant corepresented coherent functor. Let $\mathcal C$ be a $\mathcal W$-small quasicategory, $c$ a vertex, and $A=\mathfrak C[\mathcal C]$. For clarity the rigidification has the objects of $\mathcal C$ and is the colimit, over its simplices $\Delta^n\to\mathcal C$, of the simplicial categories $\mathfrak C[\Delta^n]$; these have objects $0,\ldots,n$, morphism simplicial sets $N(P_{i,j})$ for $i\leq j$, where $P_{i,j}$ is the inclusion poset of subsets of $\{i,\ldots,j\}$ containing both endpoints, and empty morphism sets for $i>j$. Composition is union of subsets. A monotone map $f:[m]\to[n]$ induces the enriched functor sending $i$ to $f(i)$ and a subset $B$ to its image $f(B)$; these functors specify the simplex diagram used in the colimit. The coherent nerve has $n$-simplices the enriched functors $\mathfrak C[\Delta^n]\to A$, with simplicial operators given by restriction. For a topological space $X$, $\operatorname{Sing}(X)_n$ consists of continuous maps $|\Delta^n|\to X$, with operators given by precomposition. In this construction topological products are compactly generated products: for a topological space $T$, its k-ification $kT$ has the subsets $V$ such that $a^{-1}(V)$ is open for every continuous map $a:Q\to T$ from a compact Hausdorff space $Q$ as its open sets, and $X\times_kY=k(X\times Y)$. Realization is the quotient realization already defined in [def-cbc-enhanced-diagrams-cones], regarded as a compactly generated space. For simplicial sets $B,D$, let $\rho_{B,D}:|B\times D|\to |B|\times_k|D|$ be the natural product comparison induced by the two projections. Form the simplicial category $A^{\mathrm{top}}$ with the same objects and morphism sets $\operatorname{Sing}|A(x,y)|$. Its composition is $\operatorname{Sing}$ of the continuous map $|A(y,z)|\times_k|A(x,y)|\xrightarrow{\rho^{-1}}|A(y,z)\times A(x,y)|\xrightarrow{|\circ|}|A(x,z)|$, using the product identification for $\operatorname{Sing}$. The identity is the singular vertex at the realization of the identity vertex of $A$. The natural unit maps give an enriched functor $A\to A^{\mathrm{top}}$. Fixing $c$ defines an enriched functor $H_c:A\to\mathbf{Kan}_{\mathcal W}$ with $H_c(x)=\operatorname{Sing}|A(c,x)|$: on an enriched morphism, its action is postcomposition in $A^{\mathrm{top}}$, after the unit map $A(x,y)\to\operatorname{Sing}|A(x,y)|$. Define
$$h_c:\mathcal C\xrightarrow{\eta}N_{\mathrm{hc}}A\xrightarrow{N_{\mathrm{hc}}H_c}\mathcal S_{\mathcal W},$$
where $\eta$ is the rigidification/coherent-nerve adjunction unit (on each simplex it is its defining enriched functor into the simplex colimit). This is the coherent functor corepresented by $c$, written $\operatorname{Map}_{\mathcal C}(c,-)$; its values model the right-pinched mapping spaces, and its postcomposition maps and higher coherences are those of the displayed enriched construction. For a coherent cocone $\lambda:F\to\Delta_I L$ with $F:I\to\mathcal C$, its image under $h_c$ is the cocone $h_cF\to\Delta_Ih_c(L)$ obtained by composing $\lambda:I\times\Delta^1\to\mathcal C$ with $h_c$. Preservation of that colimit means precisely that this image cocone is colimiting in $\mathcal S_{\mathcal W}$, in the sense of [def-cbc-enhanced-diagrams-cones].

source.place: Definition 1.2.16.1 and Remarks 1.2.16.2–1.2.16.4 (space category, including size variants); §5.1.3 opening construction, printed pp. 319–320 (rigidification followed by Sing of geometric realization of enriched Hom, restricted to a fixed first object); Definitions 1.1.5.1, 1.1.5.5 and adjunction in §2.2.1 for rigidification and coherent nerve. Read online; not archived in literature/. No Stacks tag defines this infinity-categorical construction. Definition 1.1.1.6 and Remark 1.1.1.7, and §1.1.4, printed pp. 18–19, specify compactly generated topological products and the product-preserving realization/Sing convention; Definition 1.1.5.3 specifies the monotone-map action on rigidification simplices.
